passages.text: Now these were the ones who sealed the document: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, and also Zedekiah, Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.
passages.sermon:
Nehemiah was the governor.
He was the son of Hacaliah.
Nehemiah sealed the document.
Zedekiah also sealed the document.
Seraiah sealed the document.
Azariah sealed the document.
Jeremiah sealed the document.
Pashhur sealed the document.
Amariah sealed the document.
Malchijah sealed the document.
Hattush sealed the document.
Shebaniah sealed the document.
Malluch sealed the document.
Harim sealed the document.
Meremoth sealed the document.
Obadiah sealed the document.
Daniel sealed the document.
Ginnethon sealed the document.
Baruch sealed the document.
Meshullam sealed the document.
Abijah sealed the document.
Mijamin sealed the document.
Maaziah sealed the document.
Bilgai sealed the document.
Shemaiah sealed the document.
All these men were priests.
These priests sealed the document.
passages.original: וְעַ֖ל הַחֲתוּמִ֑ים נְחֶמְיָ֧ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֛תָא בֶּן־ חֲכַלְיָ֖ה וְצִדְקִיָּֽה׃ שְׂרָיָ֥ה עֲזַרְיָ֖ה יִרְמְיָֽה׃ פַּשְׁח֥וּר אֲמַרְיָ֖ה מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃ חַטּ֥וּשׁ שְׁבַנְיָ֖ה מַלּֽוּךְ׃ חָרִ֥ם מְרֵמ֖וֹת עֹֽבַדְיָֽה׃ דָּנִיֵּ֥אל גִּנְּת֖וֹן בָּרֽוּךְ׃ מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם אֲבִיָּ֖ה מִיָּמִֽן׃ מַֽעַזְיָ֥ה בִלְגַּ֖י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֑ה אֵ֖לֶּה הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃ס

passages.text: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel, and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan, Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah, Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a group of leaders in Israel.
Jeshua is the son of Azaniah.
Binnui belongs to the family of Henadad.
Kadmiel is also a Levite leader.
These Levites have associates.
Their associates are Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, and Hanan.
Other associates are Mica, Rehob, and Hashabiah.
Zaccur and Sherebiah are also among them.
Shebaniah, Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu are included as well.
These men are all Levites.
passages.original: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְיֵשׁ֙וּעַ֙ בֶּן־ אֲזַנְיָ֔ה בִּנּ֕וּי מִבְּנֵ֥י חֵנָדָ֖ד קַדְמִיאֵֽל׃ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁבַנְיָ֧ה הֽוֹדִיָּ֛ה קְלִיטָ֖א פְּלָאיָ֥ה חָנָֽן׃ מִיכָ֥א רְח֖וֹב חֲשַׁבְיָֽה׃ זַכּ֥וּר שֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֖ה שְׁבַנְיָֽה׃ הוֹדִיָּ֥ה בָנִ֖י בְּנִֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: And the leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani, Bunni, Azgad, Bebai, Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin, Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur, Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai, Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai, Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir, Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua, Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah, Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub, Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek, Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah, Ahijah, Hanan, Anan, Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.
passages.sermon:
These are the leaders of the people.
Their names are:
Parosh.
Pahath-moab.
Elam.
Zattu.
Bani.
Bunni.
Azgad.
Bebai.
Adonijah.
Bigvai.
Adin.
Ater.
Hezekiah.
Azzur.
Hodiah.
Hashum.
Bezai.
Hariph.
Anathoth.
Nebai.
Magpiash.
Meshullam.
Hezir.
Meshezabel.
Zadok.
Jaddua.
Pelatiah.
Hanan.
Anaiah.
Hoshea.
Hananiah.
Hasshub.
Hallohesh.
Pilha.
Shobek.
Rehum.
Hashabnah.
Maaseiah.
Ahijah.
Hanan.
Anan.
Malluch.
Harim.
Baanah.
passages.original: רָאשֵׁ֖י הָעָ֑ם פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי׃ בֻּנִּ֥י עַזְגָּ֖ד בֵּבָֽי׃ אֲדֹנִיָּ֥ה בִגְוַ֖י עָדִֽין׃ אָטֵ֥ר חִזְקִיָּ֖ה עַזּֽוּר׃ הוֹדִיָּ֥ה חָשֻׁ֖ם בֵּצָֽי׃ חָרִ֥יף עֲנָת֖וֹת נוֹבָי׃ מַגְפִּיעָ֥שׁ מְשֻׁלָּ֖ם חֵזִֽיר׃ מְשֵׁיזַבְאֵ֥ל צָד֖וֹק יַדּֽוּעַ׃ פְּלַטְיָ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עֲנָיָֽה׃ הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ חֲנַנְיָ֖ה חַשּֽׁוּב׃ הַלּוֹחֵ֥שׁ פִּלְחָ֖א שׁוֹבֵֽק׃ רְח֥וּם חֲשַׁבְנָ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂיָֽה׃ וַאֲחִיָּ֥ה חָנָ֖ן עָנָֽן׃ מַלּ֥וּךְ חָרִ֖ם בַּעֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: “The rest of the people—the priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants, and all who had separated themselves from the people of the land to obey the Law of God—along with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand, hereby join with their noble brothers and commit themselves with a sworn oath to follow the Law of God given through His servant Moses and to carefully obey all the commandments, ordinances, and statutes of the LORD our Lord.
passages.sermon:
The rest of the people joined together.
These people included the priests.
They included the Levites.
They included the gatekeepers.
They included the singers.
They included the temple servants.
They included everyone who had separated themselves from the people of the land.
They did this to obey the Law of God.
Their wives joined them.
Their sons and daughters joined them.
Every son and daughter who could understand joined them.
All these people joined with their noble brothers.
They made a sworn oath together.
They promised to follow the Law of God.
God gave this Law through His servant Moses.
They promised to obey all the commandments of the LORD our Lord.
They promised to obey all His rules.
They promised to obey all His statutes.
passages.original: וּשְׁאָ֣ר הָעָ֡ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ֠לְוִיִּם הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֨ים הַמְשֹׁרְרִ֜ים הַנְּתִינִ֗ים וְֽכָל־ הַנִּבְדָּ֞ל מֵעַמֵּ֤י הָאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֶל־ תּוֹרַ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים נְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם בְּנֵיהֶ֣ם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֖ל יוֹדֵ֥עַ מֵבִֽין׃ מַחֲזִיקִ֣ים עַל־ אֲחֵיהֶם֮ אַדִּירֵיהֶם֒ וּבָאִ֞ים בְּאָלָ֣ה וּבִשְׁבוּעָ֗ה לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּנָ֔ה בְּיַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְלִשְׁמ֣וֹר וְלַעֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֲדֹנֵ֔ינוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו וְחֻקָּֽיו׃

passages.text: We will not give our daughters in marriage to the people of the land, and we will not take their daughters for our sons.
passages.sermon: The people of Israel made a promise.\r\nThey promised not to give their daughters as wives to the people of the land.\r\nThey also promised not to take the daughters of the people of the land as wives for their sons.
passages.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ נִתֵּ֥ן בְּנֹתֵ֖ינוּ לְעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאֶת־ בְּנֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִקַּ֖ח לְבָנֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: When the people of the land bring merchandise or any kind of grain to sell on the Sabbath day, we will not buy from them on a Sabbath or holy day. Every seventh year we will let the fields lie fallow, and will cancel every debt.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel made a promise to God.
They promised to obey His Law.
The people of the land sometimes bring goods to sell.
They bring merchandise and grain.
They come to sell these things on the Sabbath day.
The Sabbath is a holy day.
We will not buy from them on the Sabbath.
We will not buy from them on any holy day.
Every seventh year, we will let our fields rest.
We will not plant or harvest in the seventh year.
Every seventh year, we will cancel every debt.
We will forgive what others owe us.
passages.original: וְעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֡רֶץ הַֽמְבִיאִים֩ אֶת־ הַמַּקָּח֨וֹת וְכָל־ שֶׁ֜בֶר בְּי֤וֹם הַשַּׁבָּת֙ לִמְכּ֔וֹר לֹא־ נִקַּ֥ח מֵהֶ֛ם בַּשַּׁבָּ֖ת וּבְי֣וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְנִטֹּ֛שׁ אֶת־ הַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖ית וּמַשָּׁ֥א כָל־ יָֽד׃

passages.text: We also place ourselves under the obligation to contribute a third of a shekel yearly for the service of the house of our God: for the showbread, for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings, for the Sabbath offerings, for the New Moons and appointed feasts, for the holy offerings, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the duties of the house of our God.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel made a promise.
They promised to give a third of a shekel every year.
They gave this money for the service of the house of God.
This money provided for the showbread.
It provided for the regular grain offerings.
It provided for the regular burnt offerings.
It provided for the Sabbath offerings.
It provided for the offerings at the New Moons.
It provided for the offerings at the appointed feasts.
It provided for the holy offerings.
It provided for the sin offerings.
The sin offerings made atonement for Israel.
This money supported all the work of the house of God.
passages.original: וְהֶעֱמַ֤דְנוּ עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִצְוֺ֔ת לָתֵ֥ת עָלֵ֛ינוּ שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ לְלֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרֶ֡כֶת וּמִנְחַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֣יד וּלְעוֹלַ֣ת הַ֠תָּמִיד הַשַּׁבָּת֨וֹת הֶחֳדָשִׁ֜ים לַמּוֹעֲדִ֗ים וְלַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ וְלַ֣חַטָּא֔וֹת לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכֹ֖ל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית־ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: We have cast lots among the priests, Levites, and people for the donation of wood by our families at the appointed times each year. They are to bring it to the house of our God to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.
passages.sermon:
The priests, the Levites, and the people are the subject.
We cast lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people.
We did this to decide who would donate wood.
Each family must bring wood at the appointed times every year.
They must bring the wood to the house of our God.
They must burn the wood on the altar of the LORD our God.
This command is written in the Law.
passages.original: וְהַגּוֹרָל֨וֹת הִפַּ֜לְנוּ עַל־ קֻרְבַּ֣ן הָעֵצִ֗ים הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּם֮ וְהָעָם֒ לְ֠הָבִיא לְבֵ֨ית אֱלֹהֵ֧ינוּ לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתֵ֛ינוּ לְעִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה לְבַעֵ֗ר עַל־ מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ כַּכָּת֖וּב בַּתּוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: We will also bring the firstfruits of our land and of every fruit tree to the house of the LORD year by year.
passages.sermon:
We are the people of Israel.
We promise to bring gifts to God.
We will bring the firstfruits of our land.
We will bring the firstfruits of every fruit tree.
We will do this every year.
We will bring these gifts to the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וּלְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־ בִּכּוּרֵ֣י אַדְמָתֵ֗נוּ וּבִכּוּרֵ֛י כָּל־ פְּרִ֥י כָל־ עֵ֖ץ שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֑ה לְבֵ֖ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And we will bring the firstborn of our sons and our livestock, as it is written in the Law, and will bring the firstborn of our herds and flocks to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God.
passages.sermon:
We will bring the firstborn of our sons.
We will bring the firstborn of our livestock.
The Law commands us to do this.
We will bring the firstborn of our herds.
We will bring the firstborn of our flocks.
We will bring them to the house of our God.
The priests serve in the house of our God.
We will give the firstborn to these priests.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ בְּכֹר֤וֹת בָּנֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּבְהֶמְתֵּ֔ינוּ כַּכָּת֖וּב בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה וְאֶת־ בְּכוֹרֵ֨י בְקָרֵ֜ינוּ וְצֹאנֵ֗ינוּ לְהָבִיא֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Moreover, we will bring to the priests at the storerooms of the house of our God the firstfruits of our dough, of our grain offerings, of the fruit of all our trees, and of our new wine and oil. A tenth of our produce belongs to the Levites, so that they shall receive tithes in all the towns where we labor.
passages.sermon:
We are the people of Israel.
We will bring the first part of our dough to the priests.
We will bring our grain offerings to the priests.
We will bring the fruit from all our trees to the priests.
We will bring our new wine and oil to the priests.
We will bring these gifts to the storerooms in the house of our God.
We will give a tenth of our land’s produce to the Levites.
The Levites will collect these tithes in every town where we work.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ רֵאשִׁ֣ית עֲרִיסֹתֵ֣ינוּ וּ֠תְרוּמֹתֵינוּ וּפְרִ֨י כָל־ עֵ֜ץ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָ֗ר נָבִ֤יא לַכֹּהֲנִים֙ אֶל־ לִשְׁכ֣וֹת בֵּית־ אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וּמַעְשַׂ֥ר אַדְמָתֵ֖נוּ לַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהֵם֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַֽמְעַשְּׂרִ֔ים בְּכֹ֖ל עָרֵ֥י עֲבֹדָתֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: A priest of Aaron’s line is to accompany the Levites when they collect the tenth, and the Levites are to bring a tenth of these tithes to the storerooms of the treasury in the house of our God.
passages.sermon:
A priest from the family of Aaron must go with the Levites.
The Levites collect a tenth from the people.
The Levites must bring a tenth of what they collect.
They bring this tenth to the storerooms in the house of our God.
These storerooms are part of the treasury in God’s house.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֧ן בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֛ן עִם־ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בַּעְשֵׂ֣ר הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַעֲל֨וּ אֶת־ מַעֲשַׂ֤ר הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂר֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ אֶל־ הַלְּשָׁכ֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית הָאוֹצָֽר׃

passages.text: For the Israelites and the Levites are to bring the contributions of grain, new wine, and oil to the storerooms where the articles of the sanctuary are kept and where the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers stay. Thus we will not neglect the house of our God.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites and the Levites must bring offerings.
They must bring grain, new wine, and oil.
They must bring these to the storerooms.
The storerooms hold the articles of the sanctuary.
The ministering priests stay there.
The gatekeepers stay there.
The singers stay there.
We will not neglect the house of our God.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אֶל־ הַ֠לְּשָׁכוֹת יָבִ֨יאוּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּבְנֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֗י אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַדָּגָן֮ הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר֒ וְשָׁם֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ הַמְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֖ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א נַעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
